scenes.title: Giving Tuesday has a new tax break
scenes.say: Giving Tuesday has a new tax break this year.

scenes.label: Cash gifts to charity you can deduct in 2026, no itemizing needed
scenes.say: Starting in twenty twenty six, you can deduct up to one thousand dollars of cash gifts, even with the standard deduction.

scenes.title: Max deduction, tax year 2026
scenes.say: Married couples filing jointly get up to two thousand. Donor advised funds don't count.

scenes.title: Give cash, keep the receipt.
scenes.say: Give cash and keep the receipt. Follow for more money math.
